messages:
Nadia R: DeployBot blocked publish for redwood/web:staging-2026-03-21-b2 — reason: provenance attestation timestamp outside allowed drift (attestation.ts=2026-03-21T15:08:32Z, registry.ts=2026-03-21T15:11:03Z) :confused:
DeployBot: publish rejected  provenance.time_skew > 2m (policy: strict-clock) 
Ethan B: hmm CI clock sync flapped on the builder pool earlier, we had a maintenance window that bumped ntp. Could be related
Lina Z: Is the attestation still valid? We don't want to rebuild if we can pin. What's the safest immediate action?
Nadia R: Suggestion: create a pinned staging tag referencing the last-known-good digest (sha256:c7d4...) and annotate with `release:manual-pin` + reason. Then let DeployBot re-run provenance verification with relaxed-clock flag for this tag only
Ops Bot: scheduled change window: hold automated promotion until 2026-03-21T17:00Z to allow manual pin + verification. Notifying PMs.
Ethan B: I'm on it. Steps I'll run:
```
# fetch existing manifest/digests
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository redwood/web --image-ids imageTag=staging-2026-03-21-b1
# copy to new tag
aws ecr put-image --repository redwood/web --image-manifest file://manifest.json --image-tag staging-2026-03-21-pinned
```
I'll add comment in DeployBot UI: "release:manual-pin builder-ntp-drift"
Lina Z: Please also attach the CI build url and build id in the comment. We need traceability for the postmortem
DeployBot: advisory  manual pin allowed per emergency policy; operator must include `buildid` and `reason` in comment
Ethan B: pinned and re-submitted for verify. DeployBot now reports: provenance check passed for staging-2026-03-21-pinned :white_check_mark:
Nadia R: Great. Follow-ups: (1) add a pre-push CI sanity step to fail if attest.ts differs from push.ts by >30s, (2) run a sweep of the last 2 hours for other pushes with timestamp drift, (3) ops: confirm NTP/chrony update didn't touch prod builders
Lina Z: I'll open a tiny incident with action items and assign. Also putting a short line in the release notes: "Staging promotion briefly held for attestation timestamp drift; manual pin applied to ensure continuity."
Ethan B: logging the commands and DeployBot comment in the incident. Will coordinate on CI assert PR now
Nadia R: thanks all. Closing thread when incident and PR linked.
